017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.tracing.otel;
018
019import java.util.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.http.tracing.TraceContextCarrier;
022
023import io.opentelemetry.context.propagation.*;
024
025/**
026 * {@link TextMapGetter} implementation that reads W3C trace-context fields from a neutral
027 * {@link TraceContextCarrier} &mdash; for example an MCP request's {@code params._meta} object
028 * &mdash; instead of HTTP request headers.
029 *
030 * <p>
031 * {@link OtelTracerHook} chains an extraction pass through this getter after an ordinary HTTP-header
032 * extraction (via {@link RestRequestTextMapGetter}) so an explicit carrier value wins while an
033 * absent/invalid one falls back to whatever the HTTP-header extraction already produced. This relies
034 * entirely on the standard {@link TextMapPropagator} contract &mdash; extraction that finds nothing
035 * usable for a given concern returns the supplied {@link io.opentelemetry.context.Context} unmodified
036 * &mdash; so no bespoke precedence-merging logic lives here or in {@link OtelTracerHook}.
037 *
038 * @since 10.0.0
039 */
040@SuppressWarnings({
041   "java:S6548" // Singleton pattern is intentional; INSTANCE is a stateless, thread-safe TextMapGetter implementation.
042})
043public final class TraceContextCarrierTextMapGetter implements TextMapGetter<TraceContextCarrier> {
044
045   /** Process-wide singleton instance. */
046   public static final TraceContextCarrierTextMapGetter INSTANCE = new TraceContextCarrierTextMapGetter();
047
048   private TraceContextCarrierTextMapGetter() {}
049
050   @Override /* TextMapGetter */
051   public Iterable<String> keys(TraceContextCarrier carrier) {
052      if (carrier == null)
053         return List.of();
054      var keys = carrier.keys();
055      return keys == null ? List.of() : keys;
056   }
057
058   @Override /* TextMapGetter */
059   public String get(TraceContextCarrier carrier, String key) {
060      if (carrier == null || key == null)
061         return null;
062      var value = carrier.get(key);
063      return (value == null || value.isEmpty()) ? null : value;
064   }
065}
